name: Image-Space vs Object-Space Parallelism
definition: Object-space tasks are performed per macro at each node, regardless of that data’s projection onto the viewing plane (forward mapping). Image-space tasks are performed per screen element (pixel or ray) via reverse mapping of a pixel into the data at a node.
summary: Image-Space vs Object-Space Parallelism classifies volume rendering by whether tasks process pixels via reverse mapping or voxels via forward mapping, dictating data distribution and redistribution needs.
